headword: {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}

definitions.explanation: The ability to respond quickly and involuntarily to stimuli. Used both in medical and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}く→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: As you age, your reflexes become slower.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦ゴールキーパー→ゴールキーパー：06585_goorukiipaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧で、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧。
examples.english: That goalkeeper has outstanding reflexes and reacts quickly to any shot.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{反射|はんしゃ}→反射：08390_hansha⟧ (reflex, reflection) and ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerves). In everyday Japanese, this term is used loosely to mean reaction speed or quick reflexes, especially in sports and driving. In medical contexts, it refers specifically to the reflex arc of the nervous system.

The expression {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/わるい (good/bad reflexes) is extremely common in daily conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have good reflexes
- {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鈍|にぶ}い→鈍い：00315_nibui⟧: to have slow reflexes
- {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train one's reflexes
- {反射神経|はんしゃしんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: reflexes are required

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {反応速度|はんのうそくど}: reaction speed — more technical, measures actual response time
- ⟦{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}→運動神経：14888_undoushinkei⟧: motor skills, athletic ability — broader term for physical coordination
- {動体視力|どうたいしりょく}: dynamic visual acuity — the ability to track moving objects
